answer: One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a walnut-sized bond of tokens tied to a verified hardware root, and to periodically solve a location-bound challenge anchored to a public landmark like a mesa or reef. Duplicate identities must each post a fresh bond and pass independent attestations, so a sybil farm of N fake agents pays N bonds plus N hardware proofs and N landmark checks, making forgery cost grow linearly while honest single agents pay once.
